title: Sci-Fi Survival Mars Alien Encounter
summary: Survival-horror game cutscene prompt for a Mars expedition, with scan UI, resource pressure, alien reveal, and player objective handoff.
prompt:
Create a 9-shot in-engine cutscene for a sci-fi survival-horror game titled Crimson Horizon. Each shot should support gameplay context: oxygen pressure, scan UI, objective clarity, alien threat reveal, and a final playable handoff.

Shot 1: Rocket launch over night city, then mission title card. Overlay: SOL 0, CREW STATUS NOMINAL.
Shot 2: Two astronauts in a capsule, Mars visible through the porthole. A resource HUD briefly shows oxygen, suit integrity, and comms.
Shot 3: Descent capsule burns through Mars atmosphere. Camera shake is cinematic but controlled for comfort.
Shot 4: Wide third-person frame on Mars surface. The landing zone, rover, and canyon objective are readable.
Shot 5: Close-up of a gloved hand scanning carved symbols. The scan UI detects unknown energy and logs codex entry 001.
Shot 6: Red warning on wrist display: OXYGEN ROUTE COMPROMISED. The player must choose shelter or signal relay.
Shot 7: Dust storm reduces visibility, using audio pings to guide the player.
Shot 8: Alien silhouette moves behind canyon rock, telegraphed but not fully revealed.
Shot 9: Cut to playable camera behind the astronaut. Objective appears: Reach the emergency habitat before oxygen drops below 20 percent.
